# ------------------------------------------------- #
# waf2cmake automatically generated root CMakeLists.txt,
# generated from the root wscript. Fix if needed before using.
# ------------------------------------------------- #

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.27)

project(cssv34-client VERSION 1.0 LANGUAGES C CXX)

# ---- target platform (replacement for conf.env.DEST_OS / DEST_CPU) ----
if(WIN32)
    set(WAF_DEST_OS win32)
elseif(APPLE)
    set(WAF_DEST_OS darwin)
elseif(ANDROID)
    set(WAF_DEST_OS android)
elseif(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux")
    set(WAF_DEST_OS linux)
else()
    string(TOLOWER "${CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME}" WAF_DEST_OS)
endif()

set(ARCH_X86 OFF)
set(ARCH_X86_64 OFF)
set(ARCH_ARM OFF)
set(ARCH_AARCH64 OFF)
string(TOLOWER "${CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR}" _waf_proc)
if(_waf_proc MATCHES "^(aarch64|arm64)")
    set(ARCH_AARCH64 ON)
    set(WAF_DEST_CPU aarch64)
elseif(_waf_proc MATCHES "^arm")
    set(ARCH_ARM ON)
    set(WAF_DEST_CPU arm)
elseif(CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P EQUAL 8)
    set(ARCH_X86_64 ON)
    set(WAF_DEST_CPU x86_64)
else()
    set(ARCH_X86 ON)
    set(WAF_DEST_CPU x86)
endif()

if(CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P EQUAL 8)
    set(ARCH_64BIT ON)
    set(ARCH_32BIT OFF)
else()
    set(ARCH_64BIT OFF)
    set(ARCH_32BIT ON)
endif()

# compatibility with CMakeLists generated by older waf2cmake versions
set(AMD64 ${ARCH_X86_64})

if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE AND NOT CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES)
    set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release CACHE STRING "Build type" FORCE)
endif()

# ---- git revision (replacement for the waf 'gitversion' tool) ----
set(GIT_VERSION "unknown")
find_package(Git QUIET)
if(GIT_FOUND)
    execute_process(
        COMMAND "${GIT_EXECUTABLE}" rev-parse --short HEAD
        WORKING_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}"
        OUTPUT_VARIABLE _waf_git_out
        RESULT_VARIABLE _waf_git_res
        OUTPUT_STRIP_TRAILING_WHITESPACE
        ERROR_QUIET)
    if(_waf_git_res EQUAL 0 AND _waf_git_out)
        set(GIT_VERSION "${_waf_git_out}")
    endif()
endif()

include(CheckCompilerFlag)

find_package(PkgConfig QUIET)

# ---- options (waf: options()) ----
# waf: -4, --32bits
option(TARGET32 "allow targetting 32-bit engine(Linux/Windows/OSX x86 only)" OFF)
# waf: -d, --dedicated
option(DEDICATED "build dedicated server" OFF)
# waf: -t, --tools
option(TOOLS "build tools" OFF)
# waf: --tests
option(TESTS "build unit tests" OFF)
# waf: -D, --debug-engine
option(DEBUG_ENGINE "build with -DDEBUG" OFF)
# waf: --use-sdl
if(NOT WIN32)
    set(_SDL_DEFAULT ON)
else()
    set(_SDL_DEFAULT OFF)
endif()
option(SDL "build engine with SDL" ${_SDL_DEFAULT})
# waf: --use-togl
if(NOT WIN32)
    set(_GL_DEFAULT ON)
else()
    set(_GL_DEFAULT OFF)
endif()
option(GL "build engine with ToGL" ${_GL_DEFAULT})
# waf: --build-games
set(GAMES "hl2" CACHE STRING "build games")
# waf: --use-ccache
option(CCACHE "build using ccache" OFF)
# waf: --disable-warns
option(DISABLE_WARNS "build using ccache" OFF)
# waf: --togles
option(TOGLES "build engine with ToGLES" OFF)
# waf: --enable-opus
option(OPUS "build engine with Opus voice codec" OFF)
# waf: --enable-speex
option(SPEEX "build engine with Speex voice codec" OFF)
# waf: --sanitize
set(SANITIZE "" CACHE STRING "build with sanitizers")

            endif()
            if(NOT DEDICATED)
                pkg_check_modules(FT2 REQUIRED IMPORTED_TARGET freetype2)
                set(FT2_LIBRARY PkgConfig::FT2)
                pkg_check_modules(FC REQUIRED IMPORTED_TARGET fontconfig)
                set(FC_LIBRARY PkgConfig::FC)
                if(APPLE)
                    set(OPENAL_LIBRARY "-framework OpenAL")
                endif()
                if(NOT APPLE)
                    pkg_check_modules(OPENAL REQUIRED IMPORTED_TARGET openal)
                    set(OPENAL_LIBRARY PkgConfig::OPENAL)
                endif()
                pkg_check_modules(JPEG REQUIRED IMPORTED_TARGET libjpeg)
                set(JPEG_LIBRARY PkgConfig::JPEG)
                pkg_check_modules(PNG REQUIRED IMPORTED_TARGET libpng)
                set(PNG_LIBRARY PkgConfig::PNG)
                pkg_check_modules(CURL REQUIRED IMPORTED_TARGET libcurl)
                set(CURL_LIBRARY PkgConfig::CURL)
            endif()
            pkg_check_modules(ZLIB REQUIRED IMPORTED_TARGET zlib)
            set(ZLIB_LIBRARY PkgConfig::ZLIB)
            if(OPUS)
                pkg_check_modules(OPUS REQUIRED IMPORTED_TARGET opus)
                set(OPUS_LIBRARY PkgConfig::OPUS)
            endif()
            if(SPEEX)
                pkg_check_modules(SPEEX REQUIRED IMPORTED_TARGET speex)
                set(SPEEX_LIBRARY PkgConfig::SPEEX)
            endif()
        endif()
    endif()
    if(ANDROID)
        set(SDL2_LIBRARY SDL2)
        set(FT2_LIBRARY freetype2)
        set(JPEG_LIBRARY jpeg)
        add_compile_definitions("HAVE_JPEG=1")
        set(PNG_LIBRARY png)
        add_compile_definitions("HAVE_PNG=1")
        set(CURL_LIBRARY curl)
        add_compile_definitions("HAVE_CURL=1")
        set(CRYPTO_LIBRARY crypto)
        set(SSL_LIBRARY ssl)
        set(ZLIB_LIBRARY z)
        add_compile_definitions("HAVE_ZLIB=1")
        if(NOT ARCH_AARCH64)
            set(UNWIND_LIBRARY unwind)
        endif()
        set(ANDROID_SUPPORT_LIBRARY android_support)
        set(OPUS_LIBRARY opus)
        set(SPEEX_LIBRARY speex)
    endif()
    if(WIN32)
        set(FT2_LIBRARY freetype2)
        set(ZLIB_LIBRARY libz)
        add_compile_definitions("USE_ZLIB=1")
        set(SDL2_LIBRARY SDL2)
        set(JPEG_LIBRARY libjpeg)
        add_compile_definitions("HAVE_JPEG=1")
        set(PNG_LIBRARY libpng)
        add_compile_definitions("HAVE_PNG=1")
        set(D3DX9_LIBRARY d3dx9)
        set(D3D9_LIBRARY d3d9)
        set(LEGACY_STDIO_DEFINITIONS_LIBRARY legacy_stdio_definitions)
        set(DSOUND_LIBRARY dsound)
        set(DXGUID_LIBRARY dxguid)
        if(OPUS)
            set(OPUS_LIBRARY opus)
        endif()
        if(SPEEX)
            set(SPEEX_LIBRARY speex)
        endif()
    endif()
endif()
if(CCACHE)
    find_program(CCACHE_PROGRAM ccache)
    if(CCACHE_PROGRAM)
        set(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_LAUNCHER "${CCACHE_PROGRAM}")
    endif()
    find_program(CCACHE_PROGRAM ccache)
    if(CCACHE_PROGRAM)
        set(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_LAUNCHER "${CCACHE_PROGRAM}")
    endif()
endif()
